text.text: Explosive charges, airstrikes, and flamethrowers can all quickly destroy fortifications
Using binoculars allows you to safely observe distant battlefields and enemies, making them very useful when calling in support

Going prone or diving can help you avoid grenade damage
Submachine guns are lightweight and easy to aim and control, but performs poorly at long range
Bolt-action rifles and semi-automatic rifles have higher accuracy and greater ammunition power
All types of rifles and light machine guns fire full-power cartridges, with very low damage falloff at long range
Light machine gun recoil is hard to control when standing, but when prone or deployed, they can provide accurate and deadly automatic fire
Some sniper weapons can switch to iron sights for dealing with close-range enemies in emergencies
When an assault is bogged down, deploy light mortars to provide sustained fire support on target positions
When facing difficult defensive tasks, properly deploying heavy machine guns and light mortars can effectively handle the pressure
Tank main guns and coaxial machine guns can spot and engage infantry from considerable distances - use cover, terrain, and fire support to deal with them
Flamethrowers can effectively destroy fortifications and armored vehicles, but cannot damage medium tanks or heavier targets
The M2 heavy machine gun fires powerful .50 BMG ammunition, which can destroy fortifications and armored vehicles
Anti-tank rifles and HEAT rifle grenades can effectively damage armored vehicles and light tanks, but struggle against medium tanks or heavier armor
Aerial bombing can easily deal with most armored targets
A medium tank's main gun can typically destroy another medium tank in 2-3 hits
"Panzerfaust" and "Panzerschreck" rockets are significantly superior to "Bazooka" rockets in both penetration and power
Carrying a wrench allows you to repair vehicle durability; a large wrench repairs 1.5 times faster than a small wrench
Machine gun rounds from strafing runs are effective against personnel and armored vehicles, but cannon-armed strafing attacks are more efficient and can damage light and medium tanks
Lack of air superiority on the battlefield will make air support unavailable or more expensive
Compared to standard weapons, more expensive or rarer guns don't necessarily have better performance
The M18 recoilless rifle has poor anti-armor efficiency, but can load HE shells for anti-personnel use
When firing anti-tank rocket launchers from high ground at lower targets, aim closer to compensate for height difference, and vice versa
Stick grenades can be thrown farther than other grenades, but have a smaller fragmentation kill radius
"Rocket Barrage" and "Rocket Launcher" support have a very large kill radius - use with caution!
Due to platform stability differences, heavy machine guns deployed at elevated positions have slightly larger shot dispersion
All machine guns mounted on armored vehicles can engage targets at longer ranges
Compared to the vanilla game, RP costs in this mod are significantly higher; it's recommended to set the RP multiplier to 100% or higher
Watch out for enemy machine gunners: they carry the most powerful weapons in their squad.
Switching mode changes the heavy machine gun's deployment method; high-position deployment allows the weapon to fire over cover or sandbags.
